summary: West kerb of busy Stamford Road beside a shopping centre, signed no stopping.
reasons: Loading zone and No Stopping signs
Narrow footpath and fence, no room off lane

drivers.seclusion: Shopping centre car park and retail buildings along the whole kerb; busy and overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the traffic lane; narrow footpath then fence, nowhere to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with turning lanes and a signalled crossing.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; signed loading and no-stopping zones.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 3 m off the line
sun_shade: Open road; shopping centre building shades the west side in the morning.
